prompt: This `GET /products` catalog listing endpoint runs the same expensive join + aggregate query against Postgres on every single call, and it's getting hit thousands of times a minute even though the underlying catalog only changes a few times an hour (via the admin create/update path below). Walk me through how you'd profile this workload and optimize the read — tell me whether caching even fits here, which cache tier you'd reach for and why, and how you'd keep the cached response from going stale after an admin edits a product.
